description: Every piece of NICE guidance filed under a condition area — e.g. all breast cancer guidance, or all guidance on type 2 diabetes — with reference numbers, titles, programme and dates. This is the complete curated list for the topic rather than a relevance-ranked search, so it is the right tool for "what has NICE published on X". Call with no topic to list the condition areas that can be asked for.
name: nice_guidance_by_topic
title: Nice Guidance By Topic
